description: Compile a workflow without deploying it and report every error, each with the node it concerns. Use it after every edit and before deploy_workflow. Checks the saved graph by workflowId, or an unsaved graph passed as nodes and edges (given with a workflowId, they replace the saved ones for this check only). Set includeCode to also get the generated Worker script and its metadata (target, bindings, size) to show the user.

edges.description: Edges to check instead of the saved ones. Pass with nodes.

includeCode.description: Also return the compiled script and metadata when valid. Default false, to save tokens.

nodes.description: Nodes to check instead of the saved ones. Pass with edges.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: validate_workflow
title: Validate workflow
